title.en: Campaign in the West: Germans across the Seine and Marne (1940-06-12)

asOfNote.zh-Hant: USMA Map 14「Situation 12 June」：圖上明示的單日戰況。控制紀錄只取這一天（[1940-06-12, 次日)）；與下一個快照之間屬推估（§9），不延長。
asOfNote.en: USMA Map 14, "Situation 12 June": a single dated situation. Control records cover that day only; the span to the next snapshot is interpolation (§9).
